blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The long break seemed to have had no effect on Magnolia import KJ Buffen after a 20-20 performance in a crucial win over Blackwater in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup. Buffen finished with 24 points and 20 rebounds as the Hotshots took down the Blackwater Bossing, 107-101, staying within the top four spot in Group B at 5-3. “That’s what we expect from him,” Magnolia coach LA Tenorio said. “Actually, it’s not really the points. Of course, scoring is his job for us. [But] what we lack is our inside presence and our rebounding. That’s been our problem ever since […]...
